title: Octo Buddy
description: A smiling octopus with eight curly tentacles that all rest flat on the table - a very stable desk figure.
use: Desk figure, pen-tip or earbud nest between the tentacles, kids gift.
material: PLA/PETG. Print as-is at 0.2 mm, 10-15% infill. No supports expected (head overhang is a shallow dome).
